name: City Council Special Meeting - City Council Reorganization Meeting - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council
  Annual Reorganization Meeting
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 7, 2022 6:30 p.m.
  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
  12:00 p.m. on December 7, 2022. Written comments will be summarized during the meeting.

  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:

  The Public may join this meeting virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

  Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Council members and staff may be participating
  in this meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e).

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82042643108
  Webinar ID: 820 4264 3108
  One tap mobile:
  +16694449171,,82042643108# or +16699009128,,82042643108#
  Or Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 205 0468 or +1 253 215 8782

  Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
  modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
  distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public
  inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers McSweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tem Pearl,
  Mayor Halpern

WELCOME AND INTRODUCTIONS BY MAYOR HALPERN

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

PRESENTATIONS:

1.  PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS TO MAYOR HALPERN

2.  CITY PRESENTATION TO MAYOR HALPERN

3.  COMMENTS BY MAYOR HALPERN

4.  COMMENTS BY FELLOW COUNCILMEMBERS TO MAYOR HALPERN

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  CERTIFICATION OF NOVEMBER 8, 2022 GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  RESULTS FOR THREE COUNCILMEMBER POSITIONS; RESOLUTION NO.
  2279-22 - Adopt Resolution No. 2279-22 ‘A Resolution of the City Council Reciting
  the Fact of the General Municipal Election Held on November 8, 2022 and
  Declaring the Results and Such Other Matters as Provided by Law’ as finalized by
  the City Clerk.

2.  OATH OF OFFICE CEREMONY

  A.  Introduction of Newly Elected City Councilmembers
  B.  Oath of Office for Newly Elected City Councilmembers Administered by
  Judge H. Jay Ford
  C.  Comments by Newly Elected City Councilmembers
  D.  Comments from other members of City Council

3.  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION – Election of the 2022-23 Mayor and Mayor
  Pro Tem

  A.  Election of Mayor
  B.  Election of Mayor Pro Tem
  C.  Oath of Office Administered by Judge H. Jay Ford
  D.  Comments by New Mayor, New Mayor Pro Tem, and Councilmembers
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ANNUAL FINANCIAL RESOLUTION NO. 2280-22 - Adopt Resolution No
  2280-22 establishing annual financial authorizations and policies.

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page
1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior
to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

ADJOURNMENT:

  Please join the City Council for a reception
  in the Community Room

This agenda was posted on Thursday, December 1, 2022 at 4:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

To access Agenda and Staff Reports go to www.wlv.org and click on “City Council Agendas, Minutes &
Video”. City Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org

  CALL TO ORDER:

  This Special Meeting of the Westlake Village City Council, Annual Reorganization
  Meeting, was called to order by Mayor Halpern on Wednesday, December 7, 2022, at
  6:30 p.m., at 31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

  Mayor Halpern led the Pledge of Allegiance following a remembrance for Pearl Harbor.

  ROLL CALL:

  PRESENT:  Councilmembers Mcsweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tern Pearl,
  and Mayor Halpern

  ABSENT:  None

  Also Present:  City Manager de Geus, Assistant City Attorney Young,
  Administrative Services Director Wilson, Planning Director Forbes,
  Deputy City Manager Eskandar, City Clerk Mann, City Engineer
  Hughes, Senior Planner Sinkula, City Traffic Engineer Wessel,
  Administrative Analyst Mott, Community Services Specialist Roush,
  Deputy City Clerk Kramer and Administrative Assistant Olkes.

j  WELCOME AND INTRODUCTIONS BY MAYOR HALPERN:

  Mayor Halpern introduced the following dignitaries in the audience: Judge H. Jay Ford,
  Micah Moss representing Congresswoman Julia Brownley, Las Virgenes Unified School
  District Board President Linda Menges, Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department Deputy
  Brian Knott, Los Angeles County Fire Department Assistant Chief Drew Smith, Greater
  Conejo Valley Chamber of Commerce President and Chief Executive Officer Danielle
  Borja, Former Westlake Village City Councilmember Bob Slavin.
   City Council Minutes - Special/Reorganization Meeting
City of Westlake Village  December 7, 2022  2

Mayor Pro Tern Pearl moved to approve the Agenda as presented. Cou ncilmember Honig
seconded the motion.

  YES:  Councilmembers Mcsweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tern Pearl,
  and Mayor Halpern
  NO:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

Mayor Halpern declared the motion passed 5-0

PRESENTATIONS:

1.  PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS TO MAYOR HALPERN

  Micah Moss representing Congresswoman Julia Brownley, Las Virgenes Unified
  School District Board President Linda Menges, Los Angeles County Sheriff's
  Department Deputy Brian Knott, Los Angeles County Fire Department Assistant
  Chief Drew Smith, Greater Conejo Valiey Chamber of Commerce President and
  Chief Executive Officer Danielle Borja all made presentations to Mayor Halpern
  commemorating his term as Mayor in 2022.

2.  CITY PRESENTATION TO MAYOR HALPERN

  Mayor Pro Tern Pearl and City Council presented Mayor Halpern with a plaque
  from the City.

3.  COMMENTS BY MAYOR HALPERN

  Mayor Halpern made his closing comments and reported on the accomplishments
  of the City during his term as Mayor.

4.  COMMENTS BY FELLOW COUNCILMEMBERS TO MAYOR HALPERN

  City Councilmembers made comments to Mayor Halpern for having served as
  Mayor in 2022.
   City Council Minutes - Special/Reorganization Meeting
  City of Westlake Village  December 7, 2022  3

  NEW BUSINESS:

  1.  CERTIFICATION OF NOVEMBER 8 1 2022 GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  RESULTS FOR THREE COUNCILMEMBER POSITIONS: RESOLUTION NO.

l  2279-22:

  City Clerk Mann presented the November 8, 2022 election results. Registered
  voters were able to vote for up to three City Councilmember seats for a four-year
  term; five names were on the ballot. Top three voter holders were Brad Halpern
  (2,715 votes), Susan Mcsweeney (2,290 votes) and Ray Pearl (2,229 votes), all
  re-elected for a four-year term from December 2022 - 2026. Westlake Village had
  6,342 registered voters with 4,295 ballots cast, resulting in 68% voter participation.
  For the 4,295 ballots cast, 721 were at Vote-Centers and 3,574 were Vote-by-Mail
  ballots. City Clerk Mann noted that the Los Angeles County Clerk/Recorder
  certified the Election results and provided the City with a copy today.

  Councilmember Honig moved to Adopt Resolution No. 2279-22 'A Resolution of
  the City Council Reciting the Fact of the General Municipal Election Held on
  November 8, 2022 and Declaring the Results and Such Other Matters as Provided
  by Law' as finalized by the City Clerk. Council member Davis seconded the motion.

  YES:  Councilmembers Mcsweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tern
  Pearl, and Mayor Halpern
  NO:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Mayor Halpern declared the motion passed 5-0

  2.  OATH OF OFFICE CEREMONY

  A.  Introduction of Newly Elected City Councilmembers

  City Manager de Geus congratulated Councilmembers Pearl, Mcsweeney
  and Halpern on their reelections for a four-year term.

  B.  Oath of Office for Newly Elected City Councilmembers Administered by
  Judge H. Jay Ford
I
J  Judge H. Jay Ford administered the Oath of Office to Councilmembers
  Pearl, Mcsweeney and Halpern.

  C.  Comments by Newly Elected City Councilmembers

  Councilmembers Pearl, Mcsweeney and Halpern gave acceptance
  speeches.
   City Council Minutes - Special/Reorganization Meeting
City of Westlake Village  December 7, 2022  4

  Councilmembers added their congratulations to Councilmembers Pearl,

3.  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

  A.  Election of Mayor

  City Manager de Geus announced that nominations were open for the
  Office of Mayor.

  Councilmember Davis moved to nominate Mayor Pro Tern Pearl for the
  Office of Mayor. Councilmember Honig seconded the motion.

  YES:  Councilmembers Mcsweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor
  Pro Tern Pearl, and Mayor Halpern
  NO:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  City Manager de Gues declared the motion passed 5-0 and congratulated
  Mr. Pearl.  -

  B.  Election of Mayor Pro Tern

  City Manager de Geus announced that nominations were open for the
  Office of Mayor Pro Tern.

  Councilmember Mcsweeney moved to nominate Councilmember Davis for
  the Office of Mayor Pro Tern. Mayor Pearl seconded the motion

  YES:  Councilmembers Halpern, Mcsweeney, Honig, Davis,
  and Mayor Pearl
  NO:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  City Manager de Gues declared the motion passed 5-0 and congratulated
  Mr. Davis.

  C.  Oath of Office Administered by Judge H. Jay Ford

  Judge H. Jay Ford administered the Oath of Office to the incoming Mayor
